Name: Winter Rain
Author: idermailer
Description:
It rains in winter. (and never storms)
Weather Report informs you of changed weather.

If "useSnowDuration" is true, it rains when it's not in specific duration(using "ChanceToRain_duration"), snows in the duration(using "ChanceToSnow_duration").
[u]If false, both chance to rain and chance to snow applied as is, and chance to sunny is a value of 1 minus these two values.[/u]

Requires SMAPI, not uses Harmony patch.
Source code is [url=https://github.com/idermailer/WinterRain]here

[/url]----------
for legacy only:
If "useSnowDuration" is false, the lower chance is taken from the higher of the two. ex) if rain chance is 0.3, snow chance is 0.2, then actual rain chance is 0.1.
